description: This file defines configuration functions for setting up testing environments for the IRC extension, including loading include patterns from environment variables and creating scoped Vitest configurations.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv

methods.name: export function createExtensionIrcVitestConfig( createExtensionIrcVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the IRC extension testing, setting default parameters including test file patterns and setup scripts.
